defs.def: the fact that you have achieved sth that you want and have been trying to do or get; the fact of becoming rich or famous or of getting a high social position 成功；胜利；发财；成名

ex.s: Ivy finally realised: Jealousy doesn’t come from the success of others — it comes when we forget our own ___9___.
ex.t: 艾薇终于意识到：嫉妒并非来自他人的成功——而是当我们忘记了自己的___9___时产生的。

ex.s: Her success is just one example of increased time at home leading to an explosion in the houseplant industry.
ex.t: 她的成功只是居家时间增多导致室内植物产业爆发的一个例子。

ex.s: Will the golden word “success” form in their minds when they review our achievements?
ex.t: 当他们回顾我们的成就时，『成功』这个金光闪闪的词会在他们脑海中浮现吗？

ex.s: Completing many courses no longer brings out the feeling of success because more than four AP classes per year is a norm set by top universities.
ex.t: 完成许多课程不再带来成功感，因为每年超过四门AP课已是顶尖大学设定的常态。

ex.s: Ultimately, success came little by little.
ex.t: 最终，成功一点一点地到来了。

ex.s: Success knocks at your door only once.
ex.t: 成功只敲你一次门。

ex.s: Follow-up studies with the children later in life showed a connection between an ability to wait long enough to obtain a second treat and various forms of success.
ex.t: 后来对这些孩子进行的跟踪研究表明，能够耐心等待以获得第二份零食的能力与各种形式的成功之间存在关联。

ex.s: Hard work is the mother of success.
ex.t: 努力工作是成功之母。

ex.s: My adviser saw this experience as a groundbreaking success, emphasising the collaborating skills I acquired.
ex.t: 我的导师将这次经历视为开创性的成功，并强调我所获得的协作能力。

ex.s: > The adviser considered the author’s experience in the lab a groundbreaking success because publishable data had been produced.
ex.t: > 顾问认为,作者在实验室的经验是一次开创性的成功,因为已经产生了可公布的数据。

ex.s: Emerging research suggests that courses in lower-ranked universities, on average, scored higher on teaching than courses in higher-ranked universities. ____37____ The absence of teaching excellence from the rankings is surprising given the link between high-quality teaching and student success.
ex.t: 新兴研究表明，平均而言，排名较低大学的课程在教学方面的得分高于排名较高的大学。____37____ 考虑到高质量教学与学生成功之间的联系，排名中缺少教学质量这一点令人惊讶。

ex.s: Many instructors continue to teach using traditional lectures, which lead to lower success rates.
ex.t: 许多教师继续使用传统的讲授式教学，导致成功率较低。

ex.s: Most importantly, Edison realized that success depended on mass electrification, which he showed in New York City.
ex.t: 最重要的是，Edison意识到成功取决于大规模电气化，他在纽约市展示了这一点。

ex.s: ____ we achieve great success in our work, we should not be too proud.
ex.t: ____我们在工作中取得巨大成功，我们也不应太骄傲。

ex.s: That movie led him into the second half of his career where his comedic presence alone could make a movie a financial success even when movie reviewers would not rate it highly.
ex.t: 那部电影将他带入了职业生涯的下半场，在那个阶段，仅凭他的喜剧魅力就能让一部电影在商业上获得成功，即使影评人评价不高。

ex.t: 尽管贝尔维尤取得了成功，自适应信号并非拥堵道路的万能药。

ex.t: 从贝尔维尤的成功中我们能学到什么？

ex.t: 获得成功有助于你成为专家。

defs.def: a person or thing that has achieved a good result and been successful 成功的人（或事物）

ex.s: D．disability cannot stop a man's pursuit of success
ex.t: D. 残疾无法阻挡一个人对成功的追求。

ex.s: The feeling of success was no longer attached to what grade I received but to the pure joy of learning.
ex.t: 成功的感觉不再与我所获得的分数挂钩，而是与学习的纯粹乐趣相连。

ex.s: Everyone is the maker of their own success.
ex.t: 每个人都是自己成功的创造者。

ex.s: Success favours those with a golden heart.
ex.t: 成功眷顾那些心地善良的人。

ex.s: A college holds the key to success.
ex.t: 大学掌握着成功的关键。

ex.s: Her strong desire for success.
ex.t: 她对成功的强烈渴望。

ex.t: 这是一个成功的案例。

ex.t: 教育是成功的关键。

ex.s: “This research also helps to prove that characteristics such as persistence -- which can be taught -- are key to a child’s life success.”
ex.t: “这项研究也有助于证明，像坚持这样的特质——是可以被教导的——是孩子人生成功的关键。”

ex.s: Success is not just about who can shout the loudest The world needs quieter people, too.
ex.t: 成功不仅仅关乎谁喊得最大声——这个世界也需要更安静的人。

ex.s: So if we send out a robot with the single instruction of fetching coffee, it will have a strong desire to secure success by disabling its own off switch or even killing anyone who might interfere with its task.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们派出一个只接到“去取咖啡”这一指令的机器人，它会强烈渴望通过 disable 自己的关闭开关、甚至杀死任何可能干扰其任务的人来确保成功。
